contract: C4, docs/protocol.md, since board ab-v16.30: the rollout of set_scopes. The receiver (part 1a, board ab-v16.31) sends this hello and answers an old daemon's set_allowlist so; the daemon (agentwatch's part 3) reads features. Every value is a sample.

oldHellos.note: A receiver before part 1a: no features. A new daemon sends it set_allowlist with an empty list, writes no allowlist line, and shows the Browser page text.
A receiver before the channels (C4): no features too.

toOldReceiver.note: A new daemon and an old receiver: the old receiver blocks every site and closes its http:/https: tabs; the relay admits no connection.
toOldReceiver.browserPage: The agent browser's extension is too old for the per-repo allowlists. Update it.

fromOldDaemon.note: A new receiver and an old daemon: the receiver applies nothing (channel main: no ch).
